bonuses.name: Torrent of Ice
bonuses.text: Your auto-attack critical strikes have a chance to send out a torrent of ice, dealing 35% of your attack power as Frost damage to enemies in front of you. This is guaranteed to occur during Unbreakable Armor.

bonuses.name: Torrent of Ice
bonuses.text: While Unbreakable Armor is active, your auto-attack critical strikes increase its duration by 2 sec, up to a maximum of 8 sec.

bonuses.name: Festering Wound
bonuses.text: Necrosis damage applies Festering Wound to the target, dealing 4% of your attack power as Shadow damage every 2 sec for 15 sec. Stacks up to 20 times.

bonuses.name: Festering Wound
bonuses.text: Scourge Strike bursts all Festering Wounds on the target, dealing 15% of your attack power as Shadow damage per wound and increasing your Strength by 25 per wound for 20 sec. A new burst replaces any existing Strength bonus.

bonuses.name: Blood Feast
bonuses.text: Each enemy hit by Blood Boil or Heart Strike grants a stack of Blood Feast, increasing the damage and healing of Death Strike by 3%, stacking up to 5 times. Lasts 20 sec.

bonuses.name: Blood Feast
bonuses.text: Death Strike overhealing is converted into an absorb shield lasting 10 sec, absorbing 45% of the overhealing, up to 12% of your maximum health.

bonuses.name: Dream Burst
bonuses.text: Starfire and Wrath have a 15% chance to fire a Dream Burst at your target, dealing Nature damage.

bonuses.name: Power of Elune
bonuses.text: Starfire and Wrath deal 4% increased damage, and have a 15% chance to grant Power of Elune for 12 sec, guaranteeing that Starfire and Wrath fire a Dream Burst.

bonuses.name: Bloodseeker Vines
bonuses.text: Rip and Rake damage has a 10% chance to cause Bloodseeker Vines to grow on the victim, dealing 35% of your attack power as Bleed damage over 6 sec.

bonuses.name: Bloodseeker Vines
bonuses.text: When Bloodseeker Vines expire, or you use Ferocious Bite on their target, they explode in thorns, dealing 30% of your attack power as physical damage to the victim and nearby enemies.

bonuses.name: Empowered Maul
bonuses.text: Your auto-attacks have a 20% chance to empower your next Maul, dealing 50% of your attack power as physical damage to your target and 25% to all other enemies in front of you.

bonuses.name: Ravage
bonuses.text: During Berserk, Mangle, Lacerate and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Maul become Ravage, dealing 250% of an empowered Maul.

bonuses.name: Symbiotic Blooms
bonuses.text: Wild Growth and Rejuvenation have a 8% chance, and Swiftmend always causes, Symbiotic Blooms to grow on the target, healing for 50% of your spell power over 6 sec.

bonuses.name: Symbiotic Blooms
bonuses.text: Symbiotic Blooms increases the healing your spells do to affected targets by 15%.

bonuses.name: Barbed Shot
bonuses.text: Your shots have a 22% chance to apply Barbed Shot to the target, causing them to bleed for 35% of your attack power over 6 sec. Each time Barbed Shot is applied, your pet stomps the ground, dealing 30% of your attack power as physical damage to all nearby enemies.

bonuses.name: Barbed Shot
bonuses.text: Each time your pet Stomps, reduce the cooldown of Call of the Wild and Rapid Fire by 2 sec, and Bestial Wrath and Kill Command by 1 sec.

bonuses.name: Marked Quarry
bonuses.text: Steady Shot grants Marked Quarry, increasing the damage of Steady Shot by 2% per stack, stacking up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

bonuses.name: Marked Quarry
bonuses.text: Aimed Shot consumes all stacks of Marked Quarry, dealing 20% of your attack power as additional damage per stack, and causes your next Arcane Shot to deal 50% more damage and cost no mana.

bonuses.name: Sentinel's Mark
bonuses.text: Consuming Lock and Load with Explosive Shot has a 45% chance to summon a Sentinel Owl, applying Sentinel's Mark to your target. Your next Explosive Shot deals 40% increased damage to the marked target.

bonuses.name: Sentinel's Mark
bonuses.text: When Sentinel's Mark is consumed, it summons a barrage of 4 lunar missiles, each dealing 30% of your attack power as Arcane damage to enemies within 10 yards.

bonuses.name: Arcane Phoenix
bonuses.text: Consuming Hot Streak summons an Arcane Phoenix to aid you for 15 sec, casting Arcane and Fire spells at your enemies. This effect has an internal cooldown of 45 sec.

bonuses.name: Kindled Momentum
bonuses.text: Consuming Hot Streak grants a stack of Kindled Momentum, increasing spell haste by 2% for 10 sec, stacking up to 5. Each spell cast by the Arcane Phoenix also grants a stack.

bonuses.name: Brain Freeze
bonuses.text: Brain Freeze causes your next Frostfire Bolt to deal an additional 50% of your spell power as damage and explode, dealing 35% of its damage to nearby enemies. Consuming Brain Freeze grants 1 charge of Fingers of Frost.

bonuses.name: Empowered Icy Lance
bonuses.text: Activating Icy Veins grants Brain Freeze. While Icy Veins is active, an Empowered Icy Lance is launched at your target every second, dealing 165% of your spell power as Frost damage.

bonuses.name: Arcane Splinters
bonuses.text: Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Barrage conjures an Arcane Splinter, dealing Arcane Damage to the target.

bonuses.name: Splinterstorm
bonuses.text: Conjuring an Arcane Splinter has a 10% chance to trigger Splinterstorm, conjuring 8 additional Arcane Splinters at your target. Splinters conjured by Splinterstorm cannot trigger Splinterstorm.

bonuses.name: Tyr's Deliverance
bonuses.text: Activating Avenging Wrath invokes Tyr's Deliverance for its duration, instantly healing up to 5 injured allies within 40 yards, then healing an injured ally every 1 sec for 35% of your spell power.

bonuses.name: Tyr's Grace
bonuses.text: Allies healed by Tyr's Deliverance or your Holy Shock gain Tyr's Grace for 12 sec, increasing healing received from your Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock by 10%.

bonuses.name: Vanguard
bonuses.text: Judgement grants Vanguard. Your next Shield of Righteousness deals 45% increased damage and heals you for 50% of the damage it deals.

bonuses.name: Vanguard
bonuses.text: Avenger's Shield refracts Holy Light onto up to 4 nearby enemies, dealing 45% of your attack power as Holy damage, and consuming Vanguard reduces its cooldown by 2 sec. While Avenging Wrath is active, every Shield of Righteousness benefits from Vanguard.

bonuses.name: Crusader's Zeal
bonuses.text: Art of War also grants Crusader's Zeal, increasing the damage of your next Crusader Strike by 70%. Crusader's Zeal can accumulate up to 2 times.

bonuses.name: Crusader's Zeal
bonuses.text: Crusader Strike empowered by Crusader's Zeal unleashes a wave of Holy energy through its target, dealing 50% of your attack power as Holy damage to the primary target and 30% to all other enemies in its path.

bonuses.name: Atonement
bonuses.text: Casting Penance against an enemy target heals all allies within 20 yards of it for 100% of the damage dealt.

bonuses.name: Atonement
bonuses.text: Casting Smite increases the damage of Penance by 25%, stacking up to 2 times. Lasts 12 sec.

bonuses.name: Surge of Light
bonuses.text: Consuming Surge of Light with Flash Heal also heals the 2 of your lowest health allies within 40 yards for 100% of the Flash Heal.

bonuses.name: Blessed Light
bonuses.text: Flash Heal cast while under Surge of Light leaves Blessed Light on the target, healing them for 35% of the Flash Heal over 6 sec.

bonuses.name: Shadow Word: Death
bonuses.text: Damaging an enemy with Shadow Word: Pain increases the damage of your next Shadow Word: Death by 150% of your spell power. Stacks up to 10 times, and Shadow Word: Death no longer causes damage to the caster.

bonuses.name: Shadow Word: Death
bonuses.text: While you have Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague and Vampiric Touch active on the same target, your Mind Blast deals 45% more damage.

bonuses.name: Deathstalker's Mark
bonuses.text: Garrote applies 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to your target for 30 sec. When you spend 4 or more combo points on Envenom against a marked target, you consume a stack, dealing 156% of your attack power as Poison damage.

bonuses.name: Deathstalker's Mark
bonuses.text: Each time you consume a stack of Deathstalker's Mark, reduce the cooldown of Vanish by 30 sec.

bonuses.name: Flawless Form
bonuses.text: Rupture periodic damage increases the damage of your next Eviscerate by 4% for 12 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

bonuses.name: Flawless Form
bonuses.text: Flawless Form makes your next Eviscerate swing a flurry of attacks, dealing 50% of your attack power as physical damage to the target and 30% to all other nearby enemies. While Blade Flurry is active, damage to non-primary targets is increased by 100%.

bonuses.name: Shadow Strikes
bonuses.text: Hemorrhage deals a secondary strike with both weapons, each dealing Shadow damage.

bonuses.name: Shadow Strikes
bonuses.text: While in Shadow Dance, your abilities strike a second time, dealing Shadow damage. When Shadow Dance ends, all nearby enemies take increased Shadow damage from you for 12 sec.

bonuses.name: Elemental Mastery
bonuses.text: Elemental Mastery makes your next 3 Lightning Bolts instant cast and deal 125% more damage.

bonuses.name: Elemental Mastery
bonuses.text: Lightning Bolt reduces the cooldown of Elemental Mastery by 1 sec, and Chain Lightning by 2 sec.

bonuses.name: Maelstrom Weapon
bonuses.text: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning deal 20% increased damage and have a 20% chance to refund the Maelstrom Weapon spent.

bonuses.name: Maelstrom Weapon
bonuses.text: Maelstrom Weapon can stack 5 additional times. Each stack of Maelstrom Weapon increases the damage of Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning by 10%. Stacks beyond 5 add damage only.

bonuses.name: Stormstream Totem
bonuses.text: Casting Nature's Swiftness summons a Stormstream Totem at your feet, healing allies within 30 yards for 60% of your spell power every 2 sec for 10 sec.

bonuses.name: Stormstream Totem
bonuses.text: While active, Stormstream Totem casts Riptide on the lowest health ally every 2 sec.

bonuses.name: Soul Anathema
bonuses.text: Haunt unleashes a demonic entity unto the soul of your target, dealing 680% of your spell power as Shadow damage over 10 sec. If reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new Soul Anathema.

bonuses.name: Soul Anathema
bonuses.text: Soul Anathema damage increased by 25%. Consuming Nightfall is guaranteed to apply Soul Anathema.

bonuses.name: Wild Imps
bonuses.text: Consuming a Molten Core charge summons 3 Wild Imps for 12 sec, each casting Fel Fireball at your primary target for 20% of your spell power as Fire damage.

bonuses.name: Empowered Imp
bonuses.text: For each 3 Wild Imps summoned, 1 becomes Empowered and casts Empowered Fel Fireball instead, dealing 100% increased damage and also dealing 12.5% of your spell power as Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yards of the impact.

bonuses.name: Crashing Chaos
bonuses.text: Chaos Bolt deals an additional 40% of your spell power as damage, and makes your next Incinerate within 12 sec an instant cast.

bonuses.name: Crashing Chaos
bonuses.text: Chaos Bolt has a 22% chance to summon an Infernal at your target for 8 sec, granting Crashing Chaos while it is active. Crashing Chaos increases Chaos Bolt and Incinerate damage by 35%.

bonuses.name: Fatal Mark
bonuses.text: Overpower has a 35% chance to reset the cooldown of Mortal Strike and reduce the cost of your next Mortal Strike by 33%.

bonuses.name: Fatal Mark
bonuses.text: Mortal Strike applies a Fatal Mark for 30 sec, stacking up to 5. Execute against a marked target consumes all marks, dealing 276% of your attack power as physical damage per mark.

bonuses.name: Bloodbath
bonuses.text: Bloodthirst critical strikes increase the damage of your next Bloodthirst by 20% for 9 sec.

bonuses.name: Bloodbath
bonuses.text: Bloodthirst has a 28% chance to apply Bloodbath to your target, causing them to suffer 25% of your attack power as Bleed damage over 6 sec. Using Bloodthirst on a target affected by Bloodbath extends the bleed by 6 sec.

bonuses.name: Violent Outburst
bonuses.text: Shield Slam deals 15% increased damage and reduces enemies' damage against you by 3% for 6 sec. Multiple stacks may overlap, up to 3.

bonuses.name: Violent Outburst
bonuses.text: Every 250 rage you spend triggers a Violent Outburst, causing your next Shield Slam to deal 200% increased damage, generate 50% more rage and grant Shield Block for 8 sec.
